user.title: BACnet IP Network Configuration
user.description: Configure the local BACnet/IP network interface. To add a specific device by IP address, fill in the target address below. Leave it empty to discover all devices on the network automatically.

data_description.local_ip: The IP address of this Home Assistant server's network interface to bind to. Include the subnet prefix (e.g. 192.168.1.100/24) so broadcasts (Who-Is discovery) work — without it, discovery on the local subnet will fail. This is NOT the BACnet device address. Leave empty for auto-detect.
data_description.target_address: IP address of the BACnet device to add (e.g. 192.168.1.50 or 192.168.1.50:47808). Leave empty to discover devices automatically via Who-Is broadcast.
data_description.target_device_id: BACnet Device Object Instance number (DOI). Only used when a target address is specified. Leave at 0 to auto-detect.
data_description.use_bbmd: Enable this if BACnet devices are on another subnet/VLAN and a BBMD is available.
data_description.bbmd_address: IP address and port of the BBMD (e.g. 192.168.2.1:47808).
data_description.bbmd_ttl: Time-to-live for the Foreign Device Registration in seconds.

discovery.title: Device Discovery
discovery.description: Searching for BACnet devices on the network. This may take a few seconds...

data_description.device_id: Choose the device you want to add to Home Assistant.

select_objects.title: Select BACnet Objects
select_objects.description: Select the BACnet objects you want to import as Home Assistant entities. Use 'Select All' to toggle all objects at once.

data_description.device_name: Name for this device in Home Assistant. Pre-filled with the BACnet objectName.
data_description.selected_objects: Check the objects you want to monitor or control in Home Assistant.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure BACnet connection
reconfigure.description: Change the network settings or the address of this BACnet device. Entities, their history and all options are kept; the integration reloads with the new settings.

data_description.local_ip: The IP address of this Home Assistant server's network interface to bind to. Include the subnet prefix (e.g. 192.168.1.100/24) so broadcasts (Who-Is discovery) work — without it, discovery on the local subnet will fail. This is NOT the BACnet device address. Leave empty for auto-detect.
data_description.use_bbmd: Enable this if BACnet devices are on another subnet/VLAN and a BBMD is available.
data_description.bbmd_address: IP address and port of the BBMD (e.g. 192.168.2.1:47808).
data_description.bbmd_ttl: Time-to-live for the Foreign Device Registration in seconds.
data_description.device_address: IP address (and optional port) of the BACnet device, e.g. 192.168.1.50 or 192.168.1.50:47808, or a routed address such as 20000:1.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the BACnet network. Verify your network settings and check the Home Assistant logs for details.
error.no_devices_found: No BACnet devices were discovered on the network. Try entering the device IP address in the 'Target device address' field.
error.device_unreachable: Could not reach the BACnet device at the specified address. Verify the IP address and port.
error.no_objects_found: No readable BACnet objects were found on this device.
error.bbmd_registration_failed: Foreign Device Registration with the BBMD failed. Verify the BBMD address.
error.invalid_ip: The provided IP address is not valid.
error.timeout: The operation timed out. The device may be unreachable.

abort.already_configured: This BACnet device is already configured.

init.title: BACnet Integration Options
init.description: Configure update behaviour, entity naming, and domain mapping for this device.

data.use_description: Use description (property id 28) instead of name
data.rescan_objects: Rescan device and manage BACnet object selection

data_description.enable_cov: When enabled, the integration subscribes to COV notifications. If the device does not support COV or subscription fails, polling is used as fallback.
data_description.cov_increment: Minimum value change on the device before a COV notification is sent (applies to analog objects only). Set to 0 to use the device's default. Example: 0.5 means a notification is sent when the value changes by at least 0.5.
data_description.polling_interval: How often all objects are polled, in seconds (minimum 10). Polling always runs; COV only adds faster updates in between.
data_description.use_description: When checked, entities will be named using the BACnet 'description' property (ID 28) instead of 'objectName' (ID 77).
data_description.rescan_objects: Rereads the device's current Object_List so you can add objects that weren't selected during setup, or pick up objects added to the device since. Currently imported objects stay selected by default.
data_description.live_metadata_properties: Properties that get their own live COV-Property subscription instead of the periodic re-read. Each one is an extra subscription on the device, and not every device supports it.

rescan_objects.title: Manage BACnet Objects
rescan_objects.description: Currently imported objects are pre-selected. Check any additional objects you want to add, or uncheck ones to remove. Domain mapping and COV overrides are preserved for objects that stay selected.

domain_mapping.title: Customize objects
domain_mapping.description: Tick the BACnet objects whose entity type, COV setting or climate temperature sensor you want to change. Objects that already have a custom setting are ticked. Unticked objects use the defaults.

customize_objects.title: Customize objects
customize_objects.description: Per object: the Home Assistant entity type, whether COV is used, and — for objects that are already a climate entity — which object provides the room temperature. Changed an object to climate just now? Save, then open the options again to pick its temperature sensor.

error.invalid_polling_interval: The polling interval must be at least 10 seconds.
error.no_objects_found: No readable BACnet objects were found on this device.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the BACnet device to rescan its object list. Make sure the device is online and try again.

confirm.title: Reset incorrect entity types

device_unreachable.title: {device} is not responding
device_unreachable.description:
Home Assistant has not received data from the BACnet device {device} for several polls, and reconnecting did not help. Its entities are unavailable until it answers again.

Check that the device is powered and on the network, that its address is still correct (you can change it via Reconfigure), and — when a BBMD is used — that the BBMD is reachable. This message disappears by itself once the device responds.

write_failed.message: The BACnet device rejected the write to {object}. Check the Home Assistant log for the reason (for example a wrong write priority or an object that is not writable).

not_a_bacnet_object.message: {entity_id} is not a BACnet object entity of this integration.

relinquish.name: Relinquish
relinquish.description: Release Home Assistant's command on a BACnet object (writes Null at a priority level), so lower priorities or the Relinquish Default take over.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Priority level to release (1-16). Defaults to the device's Write Priority.

write_value.name: Write value
write_value.description: Write a value to a BACnet object's present value once, at a chosen priority, without changing the device's Write Priority setting.

value.name: Value
value.description: Value to write. Binary objects: 0 = inactive, 1 = active.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Priority level to write at (1-16). Defaults to the device's Write Priority.
